title: Phosphoresce

inlines.v: PHOSPHORESCE, verb intransitive phosphoress'. [See Phosphorus.] To shine, as phosphorus, by exhibiting a faint light without sensible heat. Arenaceous limestone phosphoresces in the dark, when scraped with a knife.
